artifacts.name: database-schema
artifacts.description: PostgreSQL DDL — all tables, indexes, triggers, constraints, views (v_org_display_names, v_person_display_names), and seed data. Source of truth for the data model.

artifacts.name: agent-guidelines
artifacts.description: Agent guidelines — project overview, development methodology (TDD), environment/tooling, project layout, admin/public API conventions, DB conventions, and the index of the reference-docs tree.

artifacts.name: reference-docs
artifacts.description: The whole reference-doc tree, indexed recursively. Domain and data: schema tables and indexes, validity windows, observation semantics, person/org names. Public API: auth, scopes, pagination, conditional requests, the change feed, and per-resource endpoint contracts. Admin dashboard: auth and archive model, HTMX partial patterns, UI components, forms, merge flows, visual style, accessibility. Operating it: everyday commands, test tiers, runbooks, recurring integrity audits, DB triage and migration. Excludes docs/plans (see design-history).

artifacts.name: design-history
artifacts.description: Dated feature design docs and implementation plans (docs/plans, YYYY-MM-DD-*.md). Historical: each records what was decided and the values in force when it was written, which may since have changed. Search it for why something was built this way; take current behaviour from reference-docs, database-schema, or the code.

artifacts.name: deployment-topology
artifacts.description: systemd units and Terraform. The API unit (power-map.service, port 8000) and the readiness probe; the scheduled timers and their paired services — datasets-pull and desired-state (the nightly ingestion chain), schema-parity, prune, anomaly, ancillary-orphans, assignment-rel-windows, egress-ip, a11y — each naming the script it runs and its cadence; and the Terraform describing the DigitalOcean database and its trusted sources. Source of truth for what runs on the VM, when, and under which unit.
